title: Playing at Pelican Park with Tis Johnson's band and Wesley Diamond
summary: Vincent played one football-game job there, with a band led by Tis Johnson, and says Wesley Diamond was a good little trumpet player.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Asked him who he worked there with.

So who you worked there with? Huh? Who did you work there with? The Highman Park? Well, I worked there with the Baton Rouge band once. You know, for a football game. Just once I worked there. Well, I had the Salisand band. That was Tis Johnson band I worked with. But Tis had two of my men, you know. Tis was a guitar player, he sang. But he was scared big at times, because I got to know these fellas. He had a guitar player, yeah, where they could play, you know. So he used to hire me, you see. Then the fellas used to say, Ooh, that fellow in there, Poppin' that corner. And she made a rest of the noise there. Hey, that little Louie's over there. And man, that guy, sure he can pop it, you know. That's Wesley Diamond? Yeah, that's the only time I played out there, you know. He said, was that Wesley Diamond on the trumpet? Yeah, that's Wesley on the trumpet, yeah.
Did he play like Louie? Yeah.
Wesley was a good little, yeah, good little trumpet player. He was so, and I, yeah.
